body.statement: Under balanced complete randomization, \[\Sigma_C(Y)=C\left\{\operatorname{diag}\left(\frac{S_{aa}(Y)}{n}\right)_{a\in\mathcal A}-\frac{S(Y)}{N}\right\}C^{\mathsf T}\] and hence \[\rho_W(Y)=\sum_{a\in\mathcal A}\frac{H_{aa}S_{aa}(Y)}{n}-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{a,b\in\mathcal A}H_{ab}S_{ab}(Y).\] Therefore all completion dependence is carried by the off-diagonal cross-arm covariances.
body.justification: This identity exposes the exact coefficients multiplying the unidentified cross-world covariances.
body.gap: Zhao and Ding state the covariance formula for arbitrary contrasts but do not use it to solve the least-favourable completion problem.
body.consumer: It converts a multi-arm causal-bootstrap integer program into a contrast-geometry diagnostic whenever pairwise rearrangement is valid.
